name: Dessau
tagline: Flat colour and plain geometry, after the Bauhaus.
description: Six Bauhaus-inspired designs, 12 wallpapers in all: each one composed separately for phone and for desktop, never cropped. Bold circles, clean lines and flat colour fields in cobalt, vermilion, mustard and black, with plenty of calm space so your clock and icons stay easy to read.
